items.text: Finding that Twin Peaks Boulevard, eastern alignment, from Christmas Tree Point Road to the southern end of the “Figure 8” roadway is no longer needed for vehicular traffic pursuant to California Vehicle Code Section 21101; and approving permanently closing Twin Peaks Boulevard to vehicular traffic except for bicycles and emergency vehicles, and changing the one-way direction of Twin Peaks Boulevard, western alignment, from Christmas Tree Point Road to the northern end of the “Figure 8” roadway to two-way as follows: A. ESTABLISH - ROAD CLOSURE, EXCEPT, BICYCLES AND EMERGENCY VEHICLES - Twin Peaks Boulevard, eastern alignment, from Christmas Tree Point Road to 1,700 feet southerly B. ESTABLISH - TWO-WAY STREET - Twin Peaks Boulevard, western alignment, from Christmas Tree Point Road to 1,500 feet southerly. (Explanatory documents include a staff report, modifications, plan, rendering, report and resolution. The proposed action is the Approval Action as defined by S.F. Administrative Code Chapter 31.)
